data.narrative:
Biobot Analytics, a Series B biotech company founded by Mariana Matus and Newsha Ghaeli, has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, with particular weight given to 4 same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables: Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), and Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $40M raised proxy, implying $76M. Peer-median anchoring across the 4 comparables yields $3.5B, reflecting the wide dispersion inherent in frontier biotech ($539M floor, $10.3B ceiling). Public-comp P/S anchoring is not feasible absent disclosed revenue data. These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $65M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty around stage progression velocity in biotech and the heterogeneity of peer business models. Key downside risk is execution risk typical of early-stage biotech; upside depends on achieving clinical or commercial inflection points consistent with the highest-valued peers.
